text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Friday it began its previously announced tender offer to acquire all the shares of Barefoot Inc for $16.00 a share.
As previously announced, ServiceMaster would pay Barefoot holders in either cash or an equivalent amount of ServiceMaster shares, at the election of the Barefoot stockholder.
The transaction has an aggregate value of about $232 million.
Completion of the deal depends upon at least 75 percent of Barefoot's 14.5 milion outstanding shares being tendered.

ServiceMaster shares will be valued at the 15-day average New York Stock Exchange composite tape closing price for the period ending February 13, unless the offer is extended, but not less than $23 a share.
ServiceMaster shares closed January 16 at $26 a share.
The tender offer and withdrawal rights expire February 21, unless extended.
After the tender is completed, the remaining shares of Barefoot will be converted into cash at $16 a share.

Barefoot is the nation's second largest lawn care company. ServieMaster is a network of service companies with two major operating segments: ServiceMaster Consumer Services and ServiceMaster Management Services, as well as two emerging business units, ServiceMaster Diversified Health Services and International.
